Alex worked at Fabrikam Analytics in Lisbon from 2019 to 2023 as an analytics engineer. At
Fabrikam Analytics, Alex built the demand forecasting dashboards for a grocery chain and worked
closely with Theo Marchetti. One of the projects there was Atlas Reporting, a reporting suite for
a retail client.
